policy.dependency_definition: A third-party service is a dependency when its outage, deletion, credential loss, quota/pricing/API/DNS/package/policy change can block a required StegVerse state transition or destroy canonical state/recovery/build reproducibility.
policy.cutover_rule: No working provider path is removed before a sovereign replacement is directly observed, dual-run verified, and provider-failure proven.

known_findings: StegVerse.ai activation completed without Vercel.
Residual Vercel references remain historical, negative-assertion, telemetry, or legacy naming.
blockers: formal outage/deletion equivalence proof
anti-regression validator

known_findings: data/ecosystem-chat-gateway.json has enabled=true and points endpoint/health/discovery to stegverse-ecosystem-chat-gateway.onrender.com.
HIL lists the Render gateway only as compatibility_fallback_not_architectural_dependency.
Sovereign runtime implementation already exists in StegVerse-org/LLM-adapter; Render removal is a Site routing/cutover problem, not a new gateway implementation problem.
Exact cutover contract is recorded in data/render-gateway-replacement-plan.json.
blockers: live same-carrier sovereign gateway observation remains pending in the canonical LLM-adapter/.github runtime lane
Site #501 currently claims scripts/check_ecosystem_chat_gateway_activation.py, so #497 must not mutate that validator until ownership is released/transferred
after sovereign observation, dual-run local discovery before removing Render static fallback

known_findings: Current verified public route is stegverse.ai -> Cloudflare edge 301 -> stegverse.org -> GitHub Pages.
blockers: sovereign redirect/routing equivalent
DNS migration/restore proof
TLS recovery proof

known_findings: Fresh canonical StegGate proof in the Site handoff uses a trycloudflare.com tunnel origin.
Stable-domain Cloudflare Worker hardening is optional, but the currently evidenced public tunnel carrier is Cloudflare-backed.
blockers: provider-neutral or StegVerse-owned public rendezvous carrier with equivalent health/self-test/evaluate proof

known_findings: Site source, workflows, and GitHub Pages publication currently depend on GitHub availability.
Current canonical custom domain is stegverse.org.
blockers: StegVerse-controlled repository/recovery mirror
off-GitHub validator/worker execution
sovereign static publication origin
artifact/release mirror

known_findings: Repository-local JSON Schema validation now replaces external jsonschema on HIL pilot/receipt scripts and three unowned workflows.
Current direct public Python package installs are reduced to validate.yml (jsonschema) and site-task-runner.yml (pip upgrade, requests, beautifulsoup4).
Those two workflow surfaces are actively owned by other Site lanes and are not mutated by #497 until ownership releases/transfers.
Public Python registry independence is therefore improved but not yet proven.
blockers: remove or sovereignly satisfy jsonschema in collision-owned validate.yml
remove or sovereignly satisfy requests/beautifulsoup4 and pip upgrade in collision-owned site-task-runner.yml
hosted validation of repository-local schema validator
prove clean execution with public Python registry unavailable

known_findings: No root package.json, package-lock.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, or yarn.lock is present.
Current npm install references are limited to self-healing/bootstrap template material, not the active Site build/runtime.
blockers: anti-regression scan must reject a future required npm dependency unless it has a sovereign mirror/offline path

known_findings: No Dockerfile, docker-compose.yml, compose.yml/compose.yaml, or render.yaml exists at Site root.
GHCR references found by the initial audit are confined to historical Ecosystem Chat executor documentation.
No active Site container build is proven to require a public container registry.
blockers: anti-regression scan must reject a future required container/base-image dependency unless the exact image digest has a StegVerse-controlled mirror

known_findings: The Site chat client posts to same-origin /api/ecosystem-chat rather than directly to a named model provider.
Repository state documents a StegVerse-owned provider service whose model bytes remain local and which does not call a hosted inference API.
OpenAI-compatible provider support is implemented as a bounded optional profile but real provider execution remains unproven/unapproved.
Claude/Gemini/OpenAI names also occur as comparison/routing vocabulary and do not by themselves prove required provider runtime use.
blockers: provider-independence scan must distinguish optional interoperability profiles from required model execution
live StegVerse-owned provider execution remains a separate activation proof, not an external-provider prerequisite

known_findings: Public DNS/TLD registration necessarily interoperates with external registry/registrar infrastructure.
StegVerse can remove single-vendor dependence through deterministic zone/state export, authoritative-DNS portability, redundant/migration-ready nameserver design, and registrar transfer readiness.
This class may not own StegVerse canonical state, execution authority, or recovery evidence.
blockers: inventory exact registrar and authoritative nameserver provider per StegVerse domain
create deterministic zone export/restore representation
prove registrar/DNS-provider migration procedure without losing canonical Site state

known_findings: The legacy HIL Cloudflare/D1 GitHub-secret workflow was physically removed from main under Site #476.
Historical failed deployment evidence is retained but current retry authority is false.
data/hil-receiver-deployment-latest.json has been reconciled to HISTORICAL_SUPERSEDED and no longer instructs workers to repopulate the retired secrets.
blockers: anti-regression validator must reject any attempt to restore the retired HIL Cloudflare/D1 GitHub-secret deployment path

known_findings: The stable-domain StegGate Cloudflare Worker is optional hardening only.
Missing Cloudflare credential values do not block tunnel-native activation.
This lane may be retired rather than activated if sovereign/provider-neutral discovery replaces its availability benefit.
blockers: decide whether sovereign discovery eliminates the need for this optional Worker entirely
do not provision provider credentials merely to satisfy an optional hardening lane

phase_1_status.note: Cloudflare is decomposed into current .ai edge, current StegGate tunnel carrier, optional stable-domain Worker hardening, and retired HIL deployment evidence. All known nodes are classified; strict reference census remains open.
